text: SEADRIF operates an insurance company in Singapore to provide rapid liquidity to governments post-disasters. Myanmar's participation in SEADRIF's governance and technical dialogue positions it to access pre-arranged financial instruments like parametric sovereign insurance. The initiative is part of a broader regional effort to enhance financial resilience against natural hazards in ASEAN.

metadata.solution_name: Engagement with the Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF) on Disaster Risk Financing in Myanmar (SEADRIF–Myanmar DRF Engagement)
